positioning: How quickly do you notice the impossible?

rounds.visualIntent: Two unmistakable people under one readable light source; two natural cast shadows, then a clearly impossible third cast shadow appears.
Recognizable ball falling toward recognizable water; a coherent splash appears before contact. Every visible droplet and splash body belongs to the same tappable semantic object.
Red ball passes behind a clearly recognizable pale vase; ball exits pale while vase becomes red.
